messages:
maya: Heads-up: eu-west batch queues spiking 09:13–09:25. GPU utilization low while queue depth hit ~120 for model rw-13b-quant, autoscaler lagged ~90s. Anyone else seeing this?
raj: Seen similar, looks like network stalls on some workers — tcp retransmits and long recv waits in pod logs around 09:12.
maya: I captured traces, attaching excerpt: ```
2026-03-17T09:12:58Z inference-worker-12 recv: 1200ms
2026-03-17T09:13:02Z inference-worker-07 send: 80ms
...
```
dana: Suggest adding a q95 panel for queue latency by zone+model. Query (draft):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_queue_time_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, zone, model))
```
sean: Also add quantile-based headroom: show q50/q90/q95 queue length and q95 batch size. Debounced alert proposal: fire when q95(queue_time) > 1.5s for 3m, with 5m silence to avoid flapping.
maya: Good — also want per-model batch_size distribution so we can see when clients send tiny batches causing low throughput. Example query:
```
histogram_quantile(0.9, sum(rate(inference_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```
raj: I'll spin up a staging dashboard patch. Which debounce window? 3m eval, 5m for suppression? :thinking: 
sean: 3m eval + 5m suppression seems fine. Also suggest tagging alerts with "region=eu-west" and include recent network error rate in the alert message.
infra-bot: Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/autoscale-queue-saturation — steps 1-4 include network checks + drop-in debounce rule for Grafana.
maya: Can we add a cost panel that multiplies spun GPUs * hours to show wasted capacity during mis-scaling? Even a simple counter helps.
dana: Yes — metric: sum(redwood_gpu_allocated) by (region) * hours, or use recorded series for gpu_hours; I'll prototype a gearbox panel.
raj: I'll open the PR against grafana-staging with panels: q95 queue_time, batch_size dist, blocked network retransmits, cost widget, and an alert rule with debounce. Expect a link in ~30m.
sean: Thanks — once on staging let's run a synthetic spike test (slow recv) to validate debounce and alert messages. :thumbsup: 
maya: Ack, thanks all. I'll monitor eu-west for the next 2 hours and paste logs if it recurs.
